recommendations.description: Add ESLint rule to enforce .js extensions on relative imports to prevent regression. Consider using 'import/extensions' rule to maintain this pattern in future contributions.
Replace barrel exports (export *) with explicit exports across the codebase to improve tree-shaking, prevent circular dependencies, and make the API surface more clear and intentional.
Use 'import type' syntax for type-only imports throughout the codebase to distinguish between type-only and runtime imports, improving tree-shaking and compilation speed.
Add documentation in contributing guidelines or README about the requirement to use .js extensions for relative imports in TypeScript files and why moduleResolution: bundler is used for development.
Consider refactoring EventDispatcher usage from inheritance to composition pattern for more flexible class structure and better separation of concerns.
Consolidate and organize exports into logical sections with comments (Constants, Core Types, Utilities) to improve code maintainability and developer experience.
